name: the gate ignores the refused rows and runs the suite (caught by test_a_row_whose_find_is_gone_stops_the_gate_before_the_suite)
the anchor half sees only the changed files' rows (caught by test_a_stale_row_on_a_file_the_branch_did_not_change_is_still_refused)
replace: wrong = mutate.anchors(tree, [row for row in rows if row["file"] in (changed or [])])

name: a changed table's rows are not compiled (caught by test_a_mutant_that_does_not_compile_is_refused_only_when_its_file_or_table_changed)
find: subset = [row for row in rows if row["table"] in named]

name: an unknown change set compiles nothing instead of every row (caught by test_a_mutant_that_does_not_compile_is_refused_only_when_its_file_or_table_changed)
a table that is not JSON stops the check with a traceback instead of a refusal line (caught by test_a_table_that_is_not_json_is_a_refusal_line)
the compile half is dropped (caught by test_a_mutant_that_does_not_compile_is_refused_only_when_its_file_or_table_changed)
find: lines += ["%s: %s" % (name, why) for name, _file, why in mutate.unloadable(tree, subset)]

name: the clean-run rows line is never printed (caught by test_a_clean_run_says_the_rows_line_and_runs_the_suite)
the changed set's related rows are left out of the compile (caught by test_a_mutant_that_does_not_compile_is_refused_only_when_its_file_or_table_changed)
find: subset += [row for row in mutate.related(rows, changed) if row not in subset]

name: a row's keys are only looked for, not checked as strings (caught by test_a_row_with_a_missing_or_not_string_key_is_a_refusal_line_not_a_crash)
find: not all(isinstance(row.get(key), str) for key in ("file", "find", "replace")):
replace: not all(key in row for key in ("file", "find", "replace")):

name: the compile count takes every row, a .md row too (caught by test_a_clean_run_says_the_rows_line_and_runs_the_suite)
a file that is not text crashes the anchor check (caught by test_a_file_that_is_not_text_is_a_refusal_not_a_crash)
find: except UnicodeDecodeError:  # a file that is not text holds no anchor
replace: except OSError:  # a file that is not text holds no anchor
